QUESTION:
What is the default value of `ingress.worker_threads`?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0407] config | quota.worker_threads (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `quota.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of worker threads used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | quota |
| Unit | threads |

## Notes

Changes to `quota.worker_threads` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[quota]
worker_threads = 8
```

---

[d0156] config | quota.worker_threads | version 4.x
# `quota.worker_threads`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of worker threads used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `4` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | quota |
| Unit | threads |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `quota.worker_threads` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[quota]
worker_threads = 4
```

# `auth.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of worker threads used by the authentication module that validates client tokens.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `2` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | auth |
| Unit | threads |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `auth.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the authentication module that validates client tokens, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[auth]
worker_threads = 2
```
